name: Checkmate! My Shogi Club President can't be this Cute!
source:
Embark on an enchanting journey filled with strategic moves, blossoming romance, and the captivating world of shogi in "Checkmate! My Shogi Club President can't be this Cute!" Immerse yourself in the heartwarming tale of a determined protagonist who sets out to win the affection of the charming and talented shogi club president. Will you be able to master the game of shogi and capture her heart?

[From [url=https://smol-kitten.itch.io/checkmate-my-shogi-club-president-cant-be-this-cute]Itch.io[/url]]
